The Maharashtra State CET Cell is expected to declare the MAH MBA CET Result 2026 by the end of May, on its official website, cetcell.mahacet.org, for the candidates who had appeared for the MBA/MMS entrance exam held from April 6 to April 8, 2026 (Session 1) and on May 9, 2026 (Session 2). Candidates shortlisted on the basis of result will be eligible to participate in Centralized Admission Process (CAP) for admission to MBA in Maharashtra.

The MAH MBA CET (Maharashtra Master of Business Administration Common Entrance Test) is a state-level entrance exam conducted by the State Common Entrance Test Cell, Maharashtra for admission into MBA/MMS programs provided by more than 330 institutes across the state. It is held annually and is a gateway for management students to secure seats in government, government-aided, university-managed & unaided MBA colleges in Maharashtra.

MAH MBA CET Merit List 2026 PDF Download

The MAH MBA CET Merit List 2026 will be released online by the State CET Cell, Maharashtra as part of the MBA/MMS admission process. The merit list will contain the names, ranks & CET scores of candidates eligible for the Centralized Admission Process (CAP) which is scheduled to begin soon. Candidates will be able to download the provisional & final merit list PDFs from the official website @cetcell.mahacet.org. To access the merit list candidates need to visit the CAP portal and click on the relevant merit list link and download the PDF file.

MAH MBA CET Result 2026 (To be Available Soon)

How to Download the MAH CET MBA Result 2026?

To check & download the MAH CET MBA Result 2026 candidates must follow the steps discussed below. The result is available only through online mode on the official website of CET Cell:

Step 1: Visit the Official Website which is cetcell.mahacet.org.

Step 2: On the homepage & click on the link named “MAH MBA CET Result” or similar.

Step 3: Enter the registered email ID & password to access the candidate dashboard.

Step 4: Once logged in, find & click on the ‘Scorecard’ or ‘View Result’ option.

Step 5: Candidates MAH MBA CET 2026 scorecard will appear on the screen. Download it & save it as a PDF for future reference in the CAP admission rounds.

MAH MBA Scorecard 2026

The MAH MBA CET Scorecard 2026 is the official document released by the Maharashtra State CET Cell that shows the performance of the candidates in the MBA/MMS entrance exam held on 6 to 8 April 2026 (Session 1) and 9 May 2026 (Session 2). It includes necessary information like candidate’s name, roll number, category, exam session, total score out of 200 & percentile. The scorecard is necessary for participating in the upcoming Centralized Admission Process (CAP) & is valid for 1 academic year.

What is a Good Score in MAH MBA CET 2026?

The MAH MBA CET 2026 good score depends on the college that a candidate is targeting. In general, a score of 140+ out of 200 can be helpful to the candidates to get 99+ percentile which is generally required for top institutes like JBIMS Mumbai, SIMSREE and Welingkar.

The candidates scoring 110 to 130 marks can also get admission in good MBA colleges through CAP rounds. As MAH MBA CET is based on percentile normalization, the final percentile will be based on the level of difficulty of the exam, the number of candidates and the overall performance of the students across different sessions.

Will CET Cell Send Scorecards by Post?

No, Maharashtra State CET Cell does not send the MAH MBA CET 2026 scorecard offline or by post. Candidates are required to download the scorecard online through the official website by using their registered email ID and password. The scorecard would be available for download in PDF format after the declaration of results.

Candidates are advised to keep multiple copies of scorecard as it will be required during CAP registration, document verification, counselling rounds and final admission in MBA/MMS colleges across Maharashtra.

Can Non-Maharashtra Candidates Apply Through CAP?

Yes, students from outside Maharashtra can also apply for MAH MBA CET CAP counselling. The participating MBA colleges include All India category seats for which the non-Maharashtra candidates can apply for admission. Depending on the admission policy, they can apply with MAH MBA CET scores or other national level exam scores accepted like CAT, CMAT, MAT, XAT or ATMA. However, the candidates having Maharashtra domicile will be eligible for the benefits of reservation and preference under state quota seats during CAP allotment process.

Is There Any Rechecking Facility for MBA CET Result?

No, generally, the Maharashtra CET Cell does not offer any rechecking or re-evaluation facility for the MAH MBA CET result once the final scorecard is published. Since the exam is computer-based and the percentile system is normalized, the scores are final. However, the candidates are provided with an opportunity to raise objections against the provisional answer key during the objection window before the results are announced. The examination authority will not entertain any further change or rechecking requests after the final answer key and result has been published.

What if I Forget My MBA CET Login Password?

In case, candidates forget the MAH MBA CET login password, they can easily recover it through the official login portal. The CET Cell provides a candidate login page to have a “Forgot Password” option. Candidates need to enter their registered email ID, mobile number or application number to reset the password. Then a reset link or OTP is sent to registered contact details. Candidates should be careful to keep their registration details safe as the same login credentials will be needed for downloading scorecard, counselling registration and CAP admission process.

Can I Use MBA CET Score for MMS Admissions?

Yes, MAH MBA CET scores are accepted for admission in MBA and MMS courses of the participating institutes of Maharashtra. Besides MBA courses, many top colleges like JBIMS, SIMSREE, PUMBA, Welingkar and SIES also accept MAH MBA CET scores for MMS admissions. The CAP is conducted by Maharashtra CET Cell which includes admission to AICTE approved MBA/MMS courses. To get admission into the desired institute and programme, the candidates need to score equal to or more than the required cutoff percentile and complete the counselling formalities.

MAH MBA CET Result 2026 FAQs

Q1: What is the validity of the MAH MBA CET 2026 result?

Ans: The MAH MBA CET Result is valid for 1 academic year 2025–26

Q2: Is revaluation or rechecking allowed for the scores of the candidates?

Ans: No revaluation or rechecking of MAH MBA CET scores is not allowed of the candidates.

Q3: What are the expected cut offs for top colleges?

Ans: Institutes like JBIMS, SIMSREE & Welingkar are expected to have cut offs above the 99.90 percentile.

Q4: What is MBA CET 2026 Result Date?

Ans. The CET Cell Result will be released in 1st week of June.

Q5: What if the candidates forget the login credentials?

Ans: Candidates can recover the password using the option of “Forgot Password” on the login page of homepage.

Q6: What is the next step after the announcement of MAH MBA CET Result?

Ans: Candidates need to appear for the CAP (Centralized Admission Process) which has registration, document verification & preference filling of colleges.

Q7: What is the date of MAH MBA CET result 2026?

Ans: The MBA CET Cell Result 2026 will be declared shortly on the official website @cetcell.mahacet.org.

Q8: Where can the candidates check the results of MBA CET?

Ans: Candidates can check & download the MAH MBA CET Result 2026 on the official website.

Q9: What are the login details to see the MHT MAH CET result of the candidates?

Ans: Candidates need registered email ID & password to login and check the result properly.

Q10. What are the details on the scorecard of the candidates?

Ans: The scorecard comprises candidate’s name, roll number, photo, signature, category, exam date & session, scaled score, percentile & result declaration date.
